title: AVP - Employee Relations and Compliances
description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

  

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.

  

Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

**The AVP – Employee Relations and Compliance** is responsible for developing, governing, and executing the employee relations and HR regulatory compliance framework for the India GCC. This role ensures adherence to applicable labour and employment laws, statutory obligations, employee relations processes, workplace investigations, and compliance governance requirements.


The incumbent will serve as the compliance subject matter expert and governance lead, partnering closely with Legal, Payroll, HR Operations, Facilities, Procurement, external labour compliance vendors, and business leaders to mitigate risk, maintain audit readiness, and ensure an equitable, compliant, and positive employee experience.


The role will be accountable for labour compliance oversight, regulatory monitoring, statutory inspections, compliance audits, policy governance, employee grievance management, disciplinary processes, and employee relations strategy across the India organization.

**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1\. Regulatory Compliance Governance**


–Own and lead the end\-to\-end employment and labour compliance framework for the India GCC.


–Ensure compliance with applicable Central and State employment laws, labour regulations, and statutory obligations.


–Establish governance mechanisms for monitoring compliance obligations, statutory filings, registrations, renewals, notices, record maintenance, and payments.


–Build and maintain a compliance calendar and compliance dashboard covering all employment\-related statutory requirements.


–Monitor regulatory changes and assess business impact, ensuring timely implementation of new compliance requirements.


–Drive compliance awareness and training programs for People leaders and employees.


–Act as the primary compliance escalation point for labour law matters.

**2\. Labour Law \& Statutory Compliance Management**


–Oversee compliance with employment related legislation


–Ensure statutory filings, registrations, renewals, inspections, notices, and returns are completed accurately and within timelines.


–Partner with Payroll and HR Operations to ensure all payroll\-linked statutory requirements are met.

**3\. Employee Relations \& Workplace Governance**


–Develop and execute the Employee Relations strategy for the GCC.


–Lead employee grievance resolution, disciplinary actions, misconduct investigations, workplace complaints, and conflict management.


–Drive fair, consistent, and legally compliant employee relations processes.


–Support leaders with performance\-related employee matters, conduct concerns, workplace disputes, and behavioral issues.


–Ensure compliance with internal policies, code of conduct requirements, and ethical standards.


–Partner with Legal where required on complex employee matters and litigation risks.


–Lead workplace investigations and ensure appropriate documentation, governance, and closure.

**4\. Compliance Vendor \& Regulatory Relationship Management**


–Manage relationships with external labour compliance vendors and legal advisors.


–Oversee labour law registrations, statutory record maintenance, compliance audits, regulatory filings, and labour inspection support through vendors.


–Coordinate responses to government authorities, inspectors, labour departments, and other regulators.


–Monitor vendor performance through SLAs, audit outcomes, compliance metrics, and governance reviews.


–Serve as the internal liaison for all labour compliance related regulatory interactions.

**5\. Audit, Risk \& Controls**


–Lead labour compliance audits and compliance self\-assessments.


–Ensure organizational readiness for internal audits, regulatory inspections, external audits, and diligence exercises.


–Conduct risk assessments and develop mitigation strategies for emerging compliance risks.


–Develop controls to ensure sustainable compliance adherence.


–Drive corrective action tracking and closure of audit observations.


–Maintain evidence repositories and statutory documentation for audit purposes.

**6\. Policy Governance \& Employee Experience**


–Own policy governance for employment\-related policies and procedures.


–Review, update, and implement policies to align with legislative and organizational requirements.


–Ensure compliance requirements are embedded into employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, transfers, promotions, leave management, separations, contractor management, and workforce engagement.


–Partner with business and People leaders to maintain a positive employee experience while ensuring compliance and risk mitigation.

**7\. Reporting, Analytics \& Governance Forums**


–Develop compliance dashboards and executive reporting mechanisms.


–Provide regular updates to GCC Leadership and People Leadership teams on compliance status, risks, audits, investigations, and corrective actions.


–Use compliance and employee relations data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Master’s degree in law, Employment Law, Labour Relations, Human Resources, or related discipline.
* Strong understanding of Indian labour laws and employment compliance and regulatory frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of employee relations and workplace governance practices
* Experience managing employment compliance audits, investigations, and labour inspections.
* Certifications in Labour Laws, Compliance, Industrial Relations, or Compliance Management are preferred.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**


–15\+ years of experience in HR Compliance, Employee Relations, Labour Relations, HR Operations, or Industrial Relations.


–Experience in BFSI GCC, multinational corporations, or regulated environments is strongly preferred.


–Experience working with external compliance and payroll vendors.


–Demonstrated experience managing labour inspections, audits, regulatory inquiries, and investigations.


–Strong experience designing scalable compliance governance frameworks.

**CORE COMPETENCY \& BEHAVIOURAL DESCRIPTION**

* Regulatory Compliance Expertise: Deep understanding of labour laws, statutory requirements, regulatory frameworks, and compliance governance.
* Employee Relations: Strong capability in grievance management, investigations, disciplinary processes, and workplace conflict resolution.
* Risk Management: Ability to identify, assess, mitigate, and monitor compliance and employee relations risks proactively.
* Audit \& Controls: Experience designing compliance controls and driving audit readiness.
* Stakeholder Management: Ability to partner effectively with business leaders, legal teams, payroll teams, regulators, and external vendors.
* Policy Governance: Strong capability in developing, reviewing, and implementing policies and compliance frameworks.
* Analytical Thinking: Ability to use compliance data and people analytics to drive decisions and identify emerging risks.
* Communication \& Influence: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence leaders at all levels.
* Investigation \& Judgment: Demonstrated capability to conduct impartial investigations and make sound risk\-based decisions.

**Job Description Summary**


We are looking for a **Lead – Workday Development** to play a hands\-on technical leadership role in enhancing and evolving AT\&T’s established Workday HCM platform. The platform has been in production for the past three years and supports critical HR integrations, workflows, applications, reporting, and automation capabilities across AT\&T’s HR ecosystem.


This role combines **Individual Contributor and Technical Lead responsibilities**. The Lead will actively architect, design, and develop complex Workday solutions while providing technical direction and guidance to the broader development team. The role will be responsible for **solution architecture, hands\-on development, resolving technical blockers, establishing engineering best practices, conducting design and code reviews, mentoring developers, and driving continuous improvement** across the Workday platform.


The ideal candidate is a strong Workday technologist who can operate at both the **architecture and implementation levels**, taking ownership of complex technical problems from solution design through production implementation and support.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

* Serve as a **hands\-on Workday developer and Technical Lead**, contributing directly to complex development while providing technical direction and guidance to the team.
* **Architect and design end\-to\-end Workday solutions**, translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, resilient, and maintainable technical designs.
* Design, develop, test, deploy, and support **Workday integrations, extensions, and automation solutions** across multiple HCM domains.

* Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve **complex technical and cross\-system issues**.

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to independently drive complex technical issues to resolution.
